## [1.6.3](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/compare/v1.6.2...v1.6.3) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* prevent boot resell config crash in Convert IAP items to Star Bux ([afe3c5e](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/commit/afe3c5eecf7f0a2c261cee9e12bcdc7bdad0ae6c))

patches.name: Disable Yodo1 analytics
patches.description: Stops the ThinkingData behavioural tracker bundled with Yodo1 MAS (endpoint c1.yodo1.com), including automatic app/screen/click/crash events.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Suppresses Yodo1 MAS banners, interstitials, rewarded videos and app-open ads, including the preloads done at SDK init. Rewarded flows still grant their in-game reward.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Grants the Pro license locally by injecting a synthetic purchase into the Distriqt billing events. Unlocks the editor and the full career content.

patches.name: Convert IAP items to Star Bux
patches.description: Converts real-money boots, Super NRG drinks, and Pro/Expert agents and trainers into Star Bux purchases in both modern and classic UI, and replaces the dead Buy Bux redirect with an in-game insufficient-funds banner.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection through the SDK's official manifest flag, while keeping push notifications and the consent UI.

patches.name: Disable Flurry analytics session
patches.description: Prevents the game from starting a Flurry analytics session without removing SDK classes or changing the consent flow.

patches.name: Disable Flurry startup measurement
patches.description: Stops the Flurry provider from capturing startup time and memory usage while keeping the component declared.

patches.name: Disable Google Play Games
patches.description: Disables broken Google Play Games auto-sign-in on re-signed APKs and hides the dead Play Games button on the Career screen (modern and classic UI).

patches.name: Disable remote config and cloud overrides
patches.description: Freezes the in-game Cloud/DLC/Cohort override system so remote updates and cached DLC files can never overwrite local patched assets or TweakValues, and speeds up startup.

patches.name: Disable retention notifications
patches.description: Prevents the game from scheduling local "come back and play" reminder notifications whenever it goes to the background.

patches.name: Enhanced replays and MP4/GIF export
patches.description: Adds a Replay Studio button during goal replays to customize playback speed, loop, slow-mo overlays, all-chance replays, and export clean HUD-free MP4 videos or animated GIFs.

patches.name: Fix text input backspace
patches.description: Fixes backspace when typing names in the game by using the in-game keyboard, which has a working delete button.

patches.name: Hide Games we like button
patches.description: Hides the promotional "Games we like" button on the Options screen in both modern and classic UI.

patches.name: Remove in-game promo interstitial
patches.description: Suppresses the game's built-in promo interstitial on all three entry paths while preserving navigation and return to play.

patches.name: Remove network interstitial ads
patches.description: Blocks loading and display of non-rewarded interstitials from AdMob and DT Exchange/Fyber while preserving rewarded videos.

patches.name: Restrict advertising ID
patches.description: Removes GAID and AdServices Ad ID permissions to reduce ad tracking, while keeping Attribution and Topics.

patches.name: Retro season selector
patches.description: Prompts to choose a historical club database (2011–2026) bundled in the APK whenever you start a new career. Existing careers are unaffected.

patches.name: Save backup and restore
patches.description: Adds a Backup button to the Career screen (modern and classic UI) to export and restore your full save via the system file picker, with automatic rollback protection.

patches.name: Unlock Pro features
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro license, ad removal, pitches/weather and special balls by setting the local license flags the game checks.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer attribution in MyTherapy
patches.description: Neutralizes the app's explicit AppsFlyer start while keeping its existing opt-out and consent paths intact.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics in MyTherapy
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection through the SDK's official manifest flag, keeping push, remote config and the consent UI.

patches.name: Disable PairIP license check in MyTherapy
patches.description: Neutralizes the PairIP license check so the re-signed APK can start, without removing its components.

patches.name: Disable Sentry diagnostics in MyTherapy
patches.description: Prevents Sentry initialization at the app's single entry point, without removing its providers or native libraries.

patches.name: Disable common ads in MyTherapy
patches.description: Stops non-rewarded banner and native ad requests at the load entry points, preserving UMP, interstitial and rewarded flows.

patches.name: Require explicit analytics consent in MyTherapy
patches.description: Treats an unregistered analytics consent as opt-out, while preserving recorded acceptance and refusal.

patches.name: Restrict advertising ID in MyTherapy
patches.description: Removes GAID and AdServices Ad ID permissions to reduce ad tracking, keeping attribution, topics and consent untouched.

patches.name: Unlock Plus benefits in MyTherapy
patches.description: Grants the local Plus state the app reads for ad-free access, extra calendar days and the PDF entry point.

patches.name: Fix Firebase after re-signing
patches.description: Restores the original certificate SHA-1 so Firebase Auth (Google login) and push notifications keep working after the APK is re-signed.

patches.name: Force Premium membership
patches.description: Rewrites the cached user model to Premium level (4020). Unlocks client-side VIP features and hides ads. Requires a fresh install.

patches.name: Remove Deals ads
patches.description: Hides the 'Deals' tab and campaign ads by forcing the local preference flags to true.
